statement.title: Waterfall
statement.l1: I build the systems other teams build apps with.
statement.l2: Architect of SOMA, the Flutter design system behind the XP, Rico and Clear apps.
statement.l3: Component governance from creation to deprecation, decisions recorded in RFCs and ADRs, and day-to-day support for the squads that use the system.
statement.l4: Before XP, I was Feature Lead on the Caju app at nav9, built offline-first and white-label apps at Fiibo, and led a team of three developers at Krykto, where I started as a junior in 2022.

soma.name: SOMA
soma.headline: Accessibility as the factory default
soma.body: I implemented WCAG accessibility across more than 250 components and created the system's widget-testing standard. Support requests per sprint dropped 40%.
soma.specimen: Illustration: a component and the semantics tree it announces to a screen reader.

morphix.name: Morphix
morphix.headline: See the change before the merge
morphix.body: I conceived and built Morphix: on every PR it renders previews, compares component versions and exposes Flutter semantics nodes. Engineering, design and product review together and catch visual and accessibility issues before they reach the app.
morphix.compare_label: Drag to compare the current version with the PR
morphix.diff_1: height 48 → 36 px, below the touch target
morphix.illustration: Illustration of a diff, not a real PR.

motion.name: Motion
motion.headline: One animation architecture, 650 places
motion.body: I planned the animation architecture used in more than 650 points of the app and built SOMA's animated chart library with CustomPainter and AnimatedBuilder. Curves, durations and choreography become tokens, not one-off decisions on every screen.
